collection.description: A patient suffers recurring agony that a healer suspects comes from a blockage deep inside the body.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A patient suffers recurring agony that a healer suspects comes from a blockage deep inside the body.

choices.label: Use rest, fluids, and careful observation.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The healer removes a hard obstruction, and the patient slowly recovers.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The healer cannot reach the cause, and the patient dies after the attempt.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The pain passes unexpectedly, and the patient recovers.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The obstruction worsens, leaving the patient too weak for surgery.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The second healer recognizes a different illness and changes the treatment.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The healers disagree, and the patient demands a clear explanation before deciding.
